1. Exemption allowed subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

This is a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C., 1973 seeking quashing of FIR No. 58/2009 dated 09.02.2009 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC, 1860 registered at Police Station Pandav Nagar and the proceedings emanating therefrom.

sentences.text: was conducted under the aegis of Delhi Mediation Centre, Karkardooma Courts, Delhi.
5. According to the terms of settlement, the parties have decided to give their marriage one more chance and have been residing together happily from the past one year.

6. According to the terms of settlement, petitioner no.1 has agreed to and assured to tender a sum of Rs.10,000/- to respondent no.2 in cash on account of day to day household expenses like food,
clothings, shelter, education, medical etc. and correspondingly, the respondent no.2/wife has also agreed to complete the matrimonial obligations.
7.
They have also further agreed that they would not quarrel with each other and would give due regard, love and affection to each other.
8. Learned counsel for the parties submit that the parties are now cohabiting together along with their minor daughter and there is no dispute between them.
9. This Court has interacted with respondent no.2, who submits that she has no quarrels left anymore and petitioner no.1 is now taking good care of her and that she is happy in her marriage.

10. Keeping in view the aforesaid, this Court is of the considered opinion that no purpose would be served in continuing the aforesaid FIR or the proceedings emanating therefrom and they ought to be This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 22/10/2023 at 00:01:55 quashed.

11. This Court is also of the considered opinion that continuation of the FIR would disrupt the perfectly happy matrimonial relation which has been reunited due to the efforts of Mediation Centre and even otherwise, it would be unjust.
12.
Accordingly, FIR No. 58/2009 dated 09.02.2009 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC, 1860 registered at Police Station Pandav Nagar and the proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
13. The petition stands disposed of.
TUSHAR RAO GEDELA, J OCTOBER 18, 2023 Aj
